WITH per_telescope AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS overall_avg
  FROM signals
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_pulse_rate, o.overall_avg
  FROM per_telescope p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE p.avg_pulse_rate > o.overall_avg
), second_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_of_kept
  FROM above_overall
), final_telescope AS (
  SELECT a.avg_pulse_rate, a.overall_avg, s.avg_of_kept
  FROM above_overall a
  CROSS JOIN second_avg s
  WHERE a.avg_pulse_rate > s.avg_of_kept
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_average_pulse_rate,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - overall_avg) AS mean_above_overall_average,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - avg_of_kept) AS mean_above_second_average
FROM final_telescope;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is computed across all nonmissing signal pulse rates, weighting each signal equally; telescope averages are computed across that telescope's nonmissing signal rates.
